_about.chapter: Items and gear: everything she can carry, drink, read, craft or own.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON. tools/build.mjs inlines this file as GAME_DB.items when it builds the game, and tools/test-game-db.cjs checks it. Entry field names stay camelCase because the game code reads them by those names. A "note" field is for people and is never read by the game.
_about.ids: Keys and id fields are saved in players' save files. Never rename one; add a new entry instead.

tables.gear: Weapons and attachments (was ITEM_REGISTRY, ui/inventory-augments.js). type: weapon | attachment. weaponMode: normal | sniper | melee | fists. stats.fireRate is frames between shots; projectileSpeed px per frame; reach px; arc radians; bleedSecs / swingSecs seconds.
tables.default_loadout: Gear ids a new game starts with (was DEFAULT_LOADOUT).
tables.augments: Dr. Yin's clinic augments (was AUGMENT_CATALOG). price in credits; slot: optic | spine | torso | cranial | arms | legs.
tables.furniture: The apartment's furniture as the inventory lists it (was APARTMENT_FURNITURE_REGISTRY).
tables.consumables: Vending machine drinks and their buffs (was CONSUMABLES, core/registries.js). cost in credits; duration in in-game minutes; modifiers[].stat: speed | flitDistance | flitCooldown | detectionRange; modifiers[].type: multiply | add. hooks names code in core/registries.js (CONSUMABLE_HOOKS) that adds unlockCheck, onActivate and onExpire.
tables.drinks: Drinks for the Crystal Glass and the cafe mugs (was GLASS_DRINKS). glass: flute | wine | martini | tumbler | coupe | soda | mug; rim px; colours are CSS.
tables.notes: Readable letters and briefings (was NOTE_REGISTRY). style: letter | briefing | ancient | digital.
tables.schematics: What the crafting table makes (was SCHEMATICS, story/missions.js). id is a gear id, or with cosmetic: true a cosmetics id. scrapCost in scrap. unlock and furniture name questState flags; requires is a cosmetic that must be owned first.

dark_maker_letter.title: A Letter from the Dark Maker
dark_maker_letter.author: Dark Maker
dark_maker_letter.body:
Dear Freelancers,

I know that you will find this. Trust, I make no mistake of your skill. I also know you survived my gift. I'm not surprised. Experts deserve expert challenges.

I've always admired your dedication, resolve, your prowess. I'm sure you can understand why I enjoy making this difficult for you. But I won't bore you. Things will step up here on out.

Now for the most important question. Where the hell am I? Eh?

Well, I left Friday the 19th after a very enjoyable stay. 10 out of 10, would recommend. I'm looking for a change of scenery now, I tire of cities for the moment.

You'll figure out where I am. You always do.

larissa_briefing_darklands.title: Mission Briefing — Darklands
larissa_briefing_darklands.author: Larissa
larissa_briefing_darklands.body:
OPERATION: RETURN TO DARKLANDS
CLASSIFICATION: PRIORITY ALPHA
HANDLER: LARISSA

The target known as the Dark Maker has been located via the Pool of Visions. He has fled to the dimension designated DARKLANDS.

You will be accompanied by Commander Luck, Black Guild Elite. Insertion point: the gated township. Local intel suggests a curse is active in the area — the spirits of Jon and Ella Malledost.

Exercise extreme caution. The Empereal Lord is watching.
